categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Matches the keyword 'ancestor' only in the context of block index ancestors; the change exclusively touches block storage and assumeutxo chainstate management.
categories.rationale: The PR does not touch transaction relay, policy, or mempool data structures.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies block index loading and candidate population in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents a startup assertion crash loop during AssumeUTXO background sync that leaves nodes unbootable without a complete reindex. If a node restarts while holding the snapshot block without its ancestors, FindMostWorkChain fails with 'Assertion failed: (pindexTest->HaveNumChainTxs() || pindexTest->nHeight == 0)', bricking startup and forcing a wipe of the snapshot chainstate.
